description_target.ambiguity_notes: The route is defined after normalizing stripe orientation: horizontal stripes are solved directly and vertical stripes are transposed into the same frame. The three-cell waypoint run identifies its middle crossing column; it is not a three-cell-wide gate or a color to preserve at the crossing.
generator_parameters: four distinct nonzero role colors: background, endpoint, stripe, waypoint
two endpoint positions and one three-cell waypoint run per stripe
negative_constraints: Do not assume black is the background; the modal color determines the background role.
Do not select colors by numeric value: endpoint, stripe, and waypoint roles are determined by their frequencies.
Do not route through an edge of a three-cell waypoint run; use its middle cell.
Do not erase or recolor cells outside the endpoint-colored route.
Do not special-case horizontal stripes; transpose vertical layouts into the same normalized construction.
semantic_primitives: identify modal background and frequency-defined object colors
find nearly full stripe lines and waypoint centers
transpose into and out of a normalized frame
solution_steps: Count colors: choose the modal background, the color appearing exactly twice as the endpoints, the remaining color appearing more than 30 times as the stripe color, and the remaining medium-frequency color as the waypoint color.
Compare the maximum row and column occupancies of stripe cells; transpose the grid when the stripes are vertical so they become horizontal.
In the normalized grid, collect each nearly full stripe row and take the middle column of its contiguous three-cell waypoint run.
Start below the upper endpoint. For each stripe in reading order, draw vertically to the row above it, horizontally to the waypoint center, and one cell through the stripe.
After the last stripe, continue vertically to the lower endpoint row and horizontally to the lower endpoint, preserving all cells not covered by the endpoint-colored path.
Transpose the result back when the input was vertically oriented.
description_target.target_text: Connect the two frequency-identified endpoint dots with an orthogonal staircase that crosses each parallel stripe through the middle of its three-cell waypoint marker; transpose vertical stripe scenes into the same construction and preserve the rest of the scene.

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule!
 ;; Two endpoint dots (the color appearing exactly twice) and a stack
 ;; of stripe walls, each pierced by waypoint marks. Route the path:
 ;; drop from the upper endpoint, elbow one row above each stripe over
 ;; to its waypoint column (middle mark when several), punch through,
 ;; and finally hook over to the lower endpoint. Vertical stripes are
 ;; solved by transposing in and out.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define freq (color-frequency g))
     (define bg (mode g))
     (define ep-color
       (find-first (lambda (c) (= (hash-ref freq c 0) 2))
                   (grid-colors g)))
     (define others
       (filter (lambda (c) (and (not (= c bg)) (not (= c ep-color))))
               (grid-colors g)))
     (define stripe-color
       (find-first (lambda (c) (> (hash-ref freq c 0) 30)) others))
     (define wp-color
       (find-first (lambda (c) (and (not (= c stripe-color))
                                    (< (hash-ref freq c 0) 30)
                                    (> (hash-ref freq c 0) 2)))
                   others))
     (define horiz
       (let ((cells (find-color g stripe-color)))
         (> (max-of (lambda (r) (count-if (lambda (p) (= (first p) r))
                                          cells))
                    (remove-duplicates (map first cells)))
            (max-of (lambda (c) (count-if (lambda (p) (= (second p) c))
                                          cells))
                    (remove-duplicates (map second cells))))))
     (define (solve gg)
       (let* ((hh (rows gg)) (ww (cols gg))
              (stripe-rows
               (filter (lambda (r)
                         (>= (count-if (lambda (c) (= (at gg r c)
                                                      stripe-color))
                                       (range 0 ww))
                             (- ww 5)))
                       (range 0 hh)))
              (eps (find-color gg ep-color))
              (upper? (< (first (first eps)) (first (second eps))))
              (start (if upper? (first eps) (second eps)))
              (goal (if upper? (second eps) (first eps)))
              (wp-cells (find-color gg wp-color))
              (marker-col
               (lambda (sr)
                 (let ((cols (sort (map second
                                        (filter (lambda (p)
                                                  (= (first p) sr))
                                                wp-cells))
                                   <)))
                   (cond ((null? cols) -1)
                         ((= (length cols) 1) (first cols))
                         (else (nth cols (quotient (length cols) 2)))))))
              (vseg (lambda (out r1 r2 c)  ;; inclusive vertical run
                      (recolor-cells out
                                     (map (lambda (r) (list r c))
                                          (range (min r1 r2)
                                                 (+ (max r1 r2) 1)))
                                     ep-color)))
              (hseg (lambda (out r c1 c2)  ;; inclusive horizontal run
                      (recolor-cells out
                                     (map (lambda (c) (list r c))
                                          (range (min c1 c2)
                                                 (+ (max c1 c2) 1)))
                                     ep-color))))
         (let loop ((cur-r (+ (first start) 1))
                    (cur-c (second start))
                    (stripes (map (lambda (sr) (list sr (marker-col sr)))
                                  stripe-rows))
                    (out gg))
           (if (null? stripes)
               (hseg (recolor-cells out
                                    (map (lambda (r) (list r cur-c))
                                         (range cur-r (first goal)))
                                    ep-color)
                     (first goal) cur-c (second goal))
               (let ((sr (first (first stripes)))
                     (mc (second (first stripes))))
                 (loop (+ sr 1) mc (rest stripes)
                       (set-cell (hseg (vseg out cur-r (- sr 1) cur-c)
                                       (- sr 1) cur-c mc)
                                 sr mc ep-color)))))))
     (if horiz (solve g) (transpose (solve (transpose g)))))))
